process.label: OUR UI/UX Process
process.heading: A clear, structured approach to UX improvement

audit.title: Audit & insight
audit.description: Every project begins with understanding how people currently use your site. We combine GA4, Hotjar, user testing and hands-on UX reviews to identify friction in core journeys.

hypothesis.title: Hypothesis & prioritise
hypothesis.description: We translate our findings into clear, actionable improvements. Each recommendation is prioritised using RICE scoring so your investment is focused on changes that will make the greatest impact first.

design.title: Design & validate
design.description: Our UX and UI designers create visual solutions in Figma. Validation may include prototype reviews, usability testing or A/B testing depending on the scale of the update.

implement.title: Implement & optimise
implement.description: Once designs are approved, our development team builds the updates. We monitor impact through analytics, heatmaps and user feedback, refining changes where needed.

checkout.title: Checkout & basket
checkout.description: Clearer layouts and stronger calls to action reduce hesitation and increase completed purchases.

navigation.title: Navigation & discovery
navigation.description: Simplified menus and improved product hierarchy help customers find what they need quickly and confidently.

mobile.title: Mobile experience
mobile.description: Optimised layouts, touch targets and imagery give customers a smoother experience across every device.

product.title: Product interaction & upsells
product.description: Refined add to basket areas and meaningful upsells increase engagement and average order value.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: WCAG-aligned design improves usability, trust and Lighthouse scores while making the experience more inclusive.

q1.question: What is included in a UX improvement project?
q1.answer: As a Birmingham-based UX design agency, we begin with a review of user behaviour and site data to understand where your eCommerce experience can improve. From there, we design and test solutions that focus on usability, clarity, navigation and conversion.

q2.question: How do you decide which improvements to make first?
q2.answer: Every opportunity is prioritised using RICE scoring so the most impactful changes are tackled early. This ensures quick wins that produce measurable results.

q3.question: How do you measure success?
q3.answer: We compare metrics such as conversion rate, revenue per session and engagement before and after updates. This data-led approach lets us see what is working and continually refine your store experience.

q4.question: Can you support ongoing UX optimisation?
q4.answer: Yes. Through our Magento support packages, we continue to improve UX, CRO and performance over time. Most clients treat us as a long-term partner for design and development improvements.

q5.question: Do you only work on Magento sites?
q5.answer: Magento and Adobe Commerce are our core platforms, but our UX and UI process works across any eCommerce website. As a UX design agency in Birmingham, we combine design, development and data to improve performance on any platform.

q6.question: What kind of ROI can we expect?
q6.answer: While every store is different, most clients see noticeable improvements in conversion and revenue within the first few months. We prioritise changes that offer meaningful improvement quickly, giving you maximum return on your investment.

cta.heading: Ready to find your technology partner?

q1.question: Can you take over an existing Magento or Adobe Commerce site?
q1.answer: We regularly onboard Magento, Adobe Commerce and Hyva stores. We begin with a full technical and performance audit to understand your setup, uncover issues and define the most impactful improvements. Whether you need quick fixes, better performance or a long-term roadmap, we can stabilise and strengthen your site.

q2.question: What makes you different from other Magento agencies?
q2.answer: We're an experienced, in-house team focused on clear communication and measurable results. You work directly with developers, designers and account managers who understand your goals and stay invested in your success, not outsourced teams or layers of account handling.

q3.question: How do you approach a new development project?
q3.answer: Every engagement starts with discovery. We learn about your systems, customers and commercial goals, then create detailed plans, wireframes and technical specifications. This ensures development runs smoothly and your final solution is aligned with both technical requirements and user needs.

q4.question: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
q4.answer: We offer flexible Magento and Adobe Commerce support packages with clear SLAs. Support includes maintenance, security patching, speed optimisation, Hyva upgrades and ongoing development so your site continues to evolve.

q5.question: How can you help my website grow?
q5.answer: We provide ongoing optimisation, including conversion rate optimisation (CRO), UX improvements, analytics, SEO, Magento performance optimisation and personalised user experiences. Our goal is to improve speed, clarity and conversion across every interaction.

q6.question: Can Magento integrate with my existing systems?
q6.answer: Absolutely. We integrate Magento and Adobe Commerce with ERP, CRM, payment gateways, shipping tools, marketing platforms and specialist B2B systems. We support both custom integrations and connections with major third-party providers.

q7.question: What eCommerce development services do you offer?
q7.answer: We deliver full eCommerce builds, platform migrations, Hyva upgrades, performance improvements, UX design, ongoing development and long-term support retainers for Magento, Adobe Commerce and Hyva stores.
